episodes.synopsis: The Boy Detectives' Club searches for answers when a security robot goes on a rampage in Shibuya in the year 203X.
episodes.title: Mirage on D. Hill

episodes.synopsis: A young woman approaches the Boy Detectives' Club and asks them to find the intended recipient of a series of threat letters her boyfriend made.
episodes.title: The Golden Tracker

episodes.synopsis: Kobayashi somehow feels that maybe he can die if he stays with Hanasaki, so he joins the Boy Detectives' Club.
episodes.title: The Hopeless on the Tower

episodes.synopsis: After school, Inoue watches Katsuta's tennis club practise before heading home, and Hanasaki tests out some tools of the Boy Detectives' Club trade.
episodes.title: Underground Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: kobayashi and Inoue are trapped in the underground channels as a result of Twenty Faces' manoeuvring.
episodes.title: Spider's Thread

episodes.synopsis: Hanasaki has been trying to help Kobayashi die, but nothing has worked; while Akechi is away, Hanasaki takes the liberty of accepting six job requests.
episodes.title: Holiday Stalker

episodes.synopsis: Akechi is relaxing at a spa to relieve the exhaustion of his recent cases; Nakamura asks him about his history with Twenty Faces, and Akechi recounts the trauma of his youth
episodes.title: Pure Tryst

episodes.synopsis: The residents of the Kokorogaoka Housing Complex refuse to vacate their homes for the sake of urban development, so they declare its independence from Japan as an autonomous borough.
episodes.title: Paradise in a Miniature Garden

episodes.synopsis: Isuzu negotiates with the police for three billion yen in exchange for the removal of the residents of the housing complex.
episodes.title: Fallen Hero

episodes.synopsis: Hanasaki flees the office after an argument with Akechi and the others; after, Twenty Faces makes an appearance.
episodes.title: Innocent Scale

episodes.synopsis: Hanasaki's act is successful in convincing Akechi and the Boy Detectives' Club that he was kidnapped by Twenty Faces.
episodes.title: Cruel Tool

episodes.synopsis: Hanasaki is brought to tears by the conversation between Twenty Faces and Akechi, even with a gun pointed at him.
episodes.title: Shade by Haze

episodes.synopsis: With the Le Waqua incident resolved and Twenty Faces in custody, the world appeared to be at peace again but the trauma of the incident left Hanasaki psychologically unstable
episodes.title: Nocturnal Dance

episodes.synopsis: Yamane Tasuku, a member of the Scientific Experiments Club, is troubled by three things: Ohtomo picks on him, he's always left behind in conversations, and he doesn't know how to become a member of the Boy Detectives' Club.
episodes.title: The Spiral Ladder

episodes.synopsis: After being out of touch for so long, Akechi calls the office; the Boy Detectives' Club receives an odd request.
episodes.title: Beetle of Conviction

episodes.synopsis: To escape the enemies targeting Fukiya, the death row prisoner they're guarding, the Boy Detectives' Club takes refuge in the abandoned building that Kobayashi had once been using as his base
episodes.title: The Beast Reborn

episodes.synopsis: Inoue and the other detectives are disheartened after being told that the Boy Detectives' Club would be disbanded; the strange air around Kobayashi has returned and is working hard to heal his wound.
episodes.title: Scattered Recoil

episodes.synopsis: Inoue and the other detectives are disheartened after being told that the Boy Detectives' Club would be disbanded; the strange air around Kobayashi has returned and is working hard to heal his wound
episodes.title: Pure Evil Mistake

episodes.synopsis: As he's resting to recover from his gunshot wound, Kobayashi has an odd dream in which he sees a woman in a bed and a man approaching her; he doesn't recognize them, but the dream gives him a strange headache.
episodes.title: Response to Malice

episodes.synopsis: Kobayashi searches for the place that he saw in his dream; Hanasaki and Hide-chan then show up and offer to help.
episodes.title: Fallen Clown

episodes.synopsis: Miyanishi was shot to death by Nakamura; during her interrogation, Nakamura testifies that Twenty Faces is actually Akechi.
episodes.title: Veracious Victim

episodes.synopsis: Akechi, stunned to learn that Nakamura was brainwashed by Twenty Faces, ends up captured by the special security force. Meanwhile, at the New Tokyo World Fair, the plane built to carry people to the stratosphere is involved in a catastrophic crash
episodes.title: Small Moth Flying into a Flame

episodes.synopsis: The Boy Detectives' Club arrives at the Space Expo; Hanasaki and Kobayashi board the shuttle for Twenty Faces' base, where Akechi is being held captive, but things don't go as planned.
episodes.title: Return of the Evening Star

episodes.synopsis: Hanasaki left Kobayashi behind and took off for Twenty Faces' hideout alone, planning to put an end to everything; Kobayashi can't accept that, so he follows him even though the aura surrounding him has already disappeared.
episodes.title: The Boy Detectives Club
